newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: both dollar and mark while yields remained steady after an initial fall. Dealers explained the reason for the strenghtening diieferntly but agreed it would continue.
"It will not stop at this. It will be hard to break through the 4.3250-level against the mark but that may happen tonight or tomorrow. The next target will then be 4.3200 crowns", one dealer said.
The German spread widened three basis points to 93 over the day.
"We have a lack of interest here because of holidays. German yields fell more on the American fall in yields yesterday", one dealer said.
Bank of Italy intervened buying marks for lire and other European central banks were rumoured to have done the same. The Riksbank were not seen in the market, dealers said.

Six month T-bill rate fell three basis points to 4.23 percent and the ten year bond yield fell five basis points to 6.49 percent. The crown firmed to 4.3385 crowns to the mark versus 4.3610 crowns on Wednesday.
